_doc: The verdict contract: the reply's last non-empty line is ONLY the verdict (optional **/`/_ markup, optional 'Verdict:' / 'Final verdict —' label, the upper-case token, optional . or !), and the nearest earlier non-empty line neither begins with a verdict token nor ends with one after a separator (':', '.', '—', '-', '|', '/', ';', '!', '?') — a stacked or listed template; a token after a word ('… or CLEAR.') does not count. Everything else is no verdict (null). A last line that is only a token is read at face value, whatever came before.
